author: Inside Edition
description: Haley Peacock is healing from a quite unusual injury: second-degree burns caused by making margaritas. It happened after she squeezed several limes by hand to create the drinks. After a day of being out in the sun all day, she woke up with swollen and painful hands that eventually began blistering. She went to the doctor, and they diagnosed her with phytophotodermatitis. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Woman Gets Second-Degree Burns On Hands After Making Margaritas
